Chronos (112) ← parentId: 103 Luna: → [004] Design Rules     — pure tempo multiplier, no state leaks

_views.text: Chronos is the global time controller of Luna. It exposes a tempo multiplier from 0.1x (very slow) to 3x (very fast) applied to all sprite rotation speeds. Play/Pause freezes all orbital motion. Reset returns tempo to 1.0x. Chronos does not know about sprites — it emits a TEMPO_CHANGE message and every subscriber adjusts its own speed. This is the one-way bus principle in action.
